name: @intentface/latch-renderer
description: Headless-Chromium renderer: render-once fetch service returning rendered text + schema.org JSON-LD + interaction affordances. Deployed as a Dockerfile Vercel Function; called by the platform's render_fetch app tool (lib/render-fetch.ts). Private — a deployable service, not a published library.

scripts.dev: npm run build && PORT=8787 node dist/server.js
